title: Jr. Finance Analyst
description:
About Us

We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems to the global mining industry. With companies in Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and South Africa, Woodgrove has built a reputation based on quality, performance, and safety. The company is entrepreneurial, dynamic and our team are driven to succeed. We are looking for like-minded individuals that want to be part of a transformational business.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Finance Analyst to input and extract accurate financial data into our financial system. The individual will research and analyze financial information to assist the company in making well-informed decisions, monitor financial transactions, and maintain operations. Responsibilities include reconciliation, accounts payable, and receivable for the Brazilian office as well as other company offices. Working closely with the finance team, the individual will ensure accuracy and efficiency in all financial processes. Strong attention to detail, proficiency in financial software, and excellent communication skills are essential for success in this role. Join our team and contribute to the financial health and success of our organization.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Maintain and update the Bill Claim Due Date Control Sheet, ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of project billing information.
  • Prepare and process monthly intercompany billings, including:
  • Engineering worked hours on WTI projects (PTS);
  • Operational overhead allocations from WSA to WTI;
  • Other billable intercompany expenses.
  • Review, validate, and distribute billable Travel & Living (T&L) expense summaries for invoicing.
  • Administer the Expensify platform, including reimbursement monitoring, project creation and maintenance, expense review, and approval.
  • Perform corporate credit card reconciliations, ensuring all transactions are properly supported and recorded.
  • Monitor and follow up on salary deductions related to travel expenses, ensuring timely recovery of outstanding amounts.
  • Maintain, promote, and support compliance with Administrative Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across the organization.
  • Prepare and review corporate Uber reports, validating travel expenses and supporting reconciliations.
  • Prepare and review corporate Cabify reports, validating travel expenses and supporting reconciliations.
  • Prepare recurring financial reports, including:
  • IOF reports;
  • Bank charges analysis;
  • Expensify reports;
  • QuickBooks reports;
  • Billable payables due from WTI.
  • Generate and distribute the monthly Expensify KPI report, monitoring reimbursement performance and compliance metrics.

Qualifications/Requirements

  • Language: English – Intermediate (Independent)
  • Education: Bachelor degree (Or ongoing) in Business administration, Accounting, Economy and related areas.
  • Relevant experience in corporate finance(PTP/OTC), or other related fields.
  • Strong working knowledge of Excel.
  • PowerBi is desirable.
  • Excellent analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills
  • Attention to accuracy and detail required.
  • Proficient in spreadsheets, databases, MS Office and financial software applications
  • Outstanding presentation, reporting and communication skills
  • knowledge of financial forecasting and diagnosis, corporate finance and information analysis
  • Well informed in current financial subjects, accounting, tax laws, money market and business environments

O cargo tem como missão assegurar que os empreendimentos avancem com agilidade, conformidade técnica e visão de viabilidade, contribuindo diretamente para o cronograma de lançamentos da incorporadora, especialmente em projetos do segmento MCMV / popular.

title: Executivo de Vendas de Campo para pequenos negócios - Mercado Pago
description:

title: Gerente de Suprimentos e Comércio Exterior
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de Suprimentos e Comércio Exterior, para agregar ao nosso time!

Missão do Cargo

Gerenciar estrategicamente os processos de compras nacionais e internacionais, garantindo o abastecimento de insumos, matérias-primas, componentes e produtos acabados, com foco em custo, qualidade, prazo e disponibilidade. Coordenar as operações de comércio exterior e acompanhar os processos de industrialização junto a fornecedores e parceiros, assegurando eficiência operacional, cumprimento dos prazos e alinhamento às necessidades do negócio.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar os processos de compras nacionais e internacionais de insumos, matérias-primas, componentes, embalagens e produtos acabados.
  • Desenvolver, homologar e gerir fornecedores nacionais e internacionais, realizando negociações comerciais de preços, prazos, condições de pagamento, volumes e contratos.
  • Desenvolver estratégias de sourcing, buscando novas alternativas de fornecedores, redução de custos e mitigação de riscos de abastecimento.
  • Acompanhar o planejamento das compras de acordo com as necessidades de demanda, estoque, produção e lançamentos de produtos.
  • Gerenciar e acompanhar os processos de importação e comércio exterior, desde a colocação dos pedidos até a chegada e disponibilização dos produtos e materiais.
  • Acompanhar embarques internacionais, documentação, desembaraço aduaneiro, prazos, custos logísticos e demais etapas do processo de importação.
  • Atuar em conjunto com despachantes aduaneiros, agentes de carga, transportadoras e demais parceiros envolvidos nas operações internacionais.
  • Acompanhar os processos de industrialização e produção terceirizada, garantindo disponibilidade dos materiais, cumprimento do planejamento e atendimento aos padrões estabelecidos pela empresa.
  • Realizar interface com fornecedores responsáveis pela industrialização, acompanhando cronogramas, capacidade produtiva, entrega de materiais e produtos acabados.
  • Monitorar indicadores da área, como saving, lead time, nível de serviço dos fornecedores, prazo de entrega, custos de importação e performance de abastecimento.
  • Identificar riscos relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos e desenvolver planos de contingência para evitar impactos no abastecimento.
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com as áreas de Planejamento, Logística, Desenvolvimento de Produtos, Qualidade, Financeiro, Fiscal e Comercial.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar o orçamento da área, buscando oportunidades de otimização de custos e melhoria de processos.
  • Liderar e desenvolver a equipe de Compras e Comércio Exterior, estabelecendo prioridades, metas e indicadores de desempenho.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Comércio Exterior, Engenharia, Economia, Logística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em Compras/Suprimentos, incluindo fornecedores nacionais e internacionais.
  • Experiência com importação e processos de Comércio Exterior.
  • Conhecimento de processos de industrialização terceirizada e gestão da cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Experiência em negociação estratégica e gestão de fornecedores.
  • Conhecimento de indicadores de Compras, Supply Chain e Comércio Exterior.
  • Excel avançado e experiência com SAP
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente, principalmente para negociação com fornecedores internacionais.
  • Desejável experiência em empresas de bens de consumo, cosméticos, beleza ou segmentos com produtos importados e industrialização terceirizada.

title: 销售部长
description:
工作职责:

1、统筹公司年度销售目标与销售策略制定,分解年度、季度及月度销售指标,确保整体业绩目标的达成与持续增长;

2、建立并完善销售管理体系,涵盖销售流程、价格政策、绩效考核与激励机制,提升销售团队执行力与人效产出;

3、负责销售渠道的整体规划与管理,包括直营网点、经销商及重点客户,优化渠道结构,提升覆盖率与单店产出;

4、带领销售团队进行客户开发与关系维护,重点推进大客户及核心客户合作,提升客户转化率与长期价值;

5、结合市场与品牌策略,推动线索高效转化,与市场部门紧密协作,确保市场线索向实际订单和交付结果有效转化;

6、监控销售数据及业务表现,定期分析销售报表、成交结构与转化漏斗,及时调整销售策略并提出改进方案;

7、跟踪行业趋势与竞争对手销售策略,分析市场变化对销售的影响,制定具有竞争力的应对措施;

8、建立并领导高绩效销售团队,负责销售人员的招聘、培训、辅导与梯队建设,持续提升团队专业能力与稳定性;

9、对销售体系核心KPI全面负责,包括但不限于销售额、成交率、回款率、库存周转率及客户满意度等关键指标;

10、确保销售行为及流程符合当地法律法规及公司合规要求;

11、完成公司和上级领导安排的其他任务。

岗位要求:

1、本科及以上学历,市场营销、工商管理等相关专业,具备系统的销售管理与商业运营知识优先;

2、具备10年以上汽车行业相关经验,其中至少3年以上海外或国际市场销售管理经验,熟悉海外市场销售运作模式优先;

3、参与或主导过海外市场销售战略规划与落地执行,包括销售目标制定、渠道建设、产品导入及本地化销售推进优先;

4、具备在多文化、多语言环境下带领销售团队的经验,能够制定并执行海外销售策略,持续推动销量与市场份额增长优先;

5、具备较强的业务洞察力与数据分析能力,能基于销售数据

、市场反馈及竞争格局,快速调整销售策略与资源投入优先;

6、熟悉汽车行业销售流程与管理机制,包括线索转化、经销商管理、价格策略、促销政策及库存与交付协同优先;

7、能够高效协同公司内部市场、产品、售后及总部相关部门,整合资源支持海外市场与销售目标达成优先;

8、擅长与海外经销商、重点客户及合作伙伴建立长期合作关系,具备较强的商务谈判与客户关系管理能力优先;

9、具备优秀的团队管理与激励能力,能够搭建并管理高绩效销售团队,推动跨部门及跨区域协作优先;

10、CET6或以上,英语能作为工作语言,具备良好的跨文化交流能力优先;

11、能够接受海外出差或外派。

title: Químico Especialista
description:

compromisso de oferecer soluções inovadoras e de alta qualidade em tintas, atendendo às mais

Estamos em busca de um(a) Químico(a) Especialista que terá a missão principal de executar atividades relacionadas ao desenvolvimento e formulação de tintas protetivas industriais, com foco em tecnologias epóxi de alto desempenho para aplicações de tank lining, flooring e proteção anticorrosiva, visando prestar atendimento aos clientes internos de forma segura e eficiente. A posição requer sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de produtos, condução de projetos de P&D e gestão do ciclo de inovação utilizando metodologias estruturadas, como Stage-Gate. Posição para trabalhar presencialmente no Laboratório de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento de P&M (Tintas Protetivas Industriais) localizado na Planta de Sumaré.

Profissional responsável por liderar atividades de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de alta complexidade para novos produtos, inovação tecnológica, avaliação e aprovação de matérias-primas, novas tecnologias, além de atuar como suporte técnico à produção e à qualidade. Coordena projetos técnicos, realiza visitas técnicas a clientes e contribui para a melhoria contínua dos processos e produtos, garantindo desempenho, qualidade e competitividade.

O desafio está em liderar projetos de inovação em um ambiente técnico e equilibrar qualidade, desempenho e viabilidade, enquanto se busca soluções para problemas complexos.

Responsabilidades

  • Gerar relatórios técnicos, elaborando documentos contendo informações inerentes a desenvolvimentos de produtos, testes de desempenho, mapeamento de linha e outros, a fim de manter histórico dos trabalhos, experimentos e conhecimentos adquiridos.
  • Liderar projeto individuais ou em grupo.

  • Atuar como recurso técnico para outros funcionários em termos e gestão de projetos.
  • Ser capaz de executar projetos do início ao fim.
  • Atender à política de qualidade, segurança e meio ambiente definidas pela empresa.

Qualificações:

  • Superior completo em Química Bacharelado ou Engenharia Química.
  • Desejável Pós-graduação.
  • Experiência mínima de 10 anos em Laboratório de Desenvolvimento atuando com formulação e desenvolvimento de tintas para proteção e manutenção industrial (obrigatório).
  • Conhecimento avançado em desenvolvimento e formulação de sistemas epóxi de alto desempenho (obrigatório).
  • Experiência comprovada em tecnologias para tank lining, flooring e revestimentos anticorrosivos industriais (obrigatório).
  • Conhecimento de normas e métodos de avaliação de desempenho para revestimentos protetivos.
  • Vivência na gestão de projetos de inovação e desenvolvimento de produtos utilizando metodologia Stage-Gate ou ferramentas equivalentes.

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
About the Job

At GeneMind, we are advancing global precision medicine and scientific discovery through innovative next-generation sequencing (NGS) technology, breaking barriers to deliver reliable, high-performance genomic solutions to laboratories, hospitals, and research institutions across the world.

Our Field Service Engineers are the frontline technical ambassadors of GeneMind, building trusted customer relationships, ensuring maximum instrument uptime, and turning technical expertise into tangible customer success. Working here means joining a mission-driven, fast-growing team where your hands-on skills directly shape the progress of genomics. Surrounded by cutting-edge technology, collaborative colleagues, and meaningful work, you will grow professionally, solve impactful challenges, and build a rewarding career in one of the most dynamic industries today.

Position Summary

Field Service Engineer

Reporting to the Service Manager, the Field Service Engineer will own end-to-end on-site and remote service delivery for GeneMind's high-precision sequencing instruments. This is a customer-centric, hands-on technical role encompassing installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, hardware troubleshooting, repair, and technical training. You will be responsible for sustaining optimal instrument performance, driving high customer satisfaction, and supporting the reliable operation of genomic testing and research workflows—this is not purely a desk-based role, but a dynamic position requiring field execution and technical problem-solving.

Key Measures Of Success

  • On-time instrument installation & commissioning with zero critical post-installation defects
  • High instrument uptime & fast resolution of hardware-related technical faults
  • Strong customer satisfaction scores and long-term customer loyalty
  • Effective knowledge transfer to distributor service teams and end-user technicians
  • Accurate & compliant service documentation, including maintenance records and repair reports
  • Proactive preventive maintenance execution to minimize unplanned downtime

Position Responsibilities

  • Prepare comprehensive materials, documentation, and packaging for instrument installation, on-site commissioning, and after-sales maintenance, ensuring full readiness for all service activities.
  • Evaluate required supplies, components, and checklists for product demonstrations, coordinate preparation efforts, and follow through to guarantee flawless demo execution.
  • Deliver responsive hardware technical support and maintenance services for customers post-sale, conducting both on-site and remote troubleshooting to resolve malfunctions efficiently.
  • Design and deliver structured technical training for distributor Field Service Engineers and customer laboratory staff, building their capability to operate and maintain instruments independently.
  • Perform routine on-site inspections to assess instrument operating status, proactively identify potential issues, and assist customers in maintaining consistent, reliable instrument performance.
  • Maintain detailed, accurate service records, project documents, and technical reports in compliance with company policies and quality management standards.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, application, and R&D teams to share customer feedback, resolve complex technical issues, and improve overall product reliability and customer experience.

Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive list, of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs.

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Automation, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Semiconductor, Mechatronics, or related technical disciplines.
  • 3+ years of hands-on hardware maintenance experience in medical devices, precision analytical instruments, or life science equipment.
  • Proficiency in instrument assembly, disassembly, circuit troubleshooting, mechanical calibration, and hardware fault resolution for high-precision equipment.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, compliant project documents, service reports, and technical records independently.
  • Strong learning agility and adaptability, with the ability to quickly master complex genomic sequencing instruments and emerging technical knowledge.
  • Good oral English proficiency; fluent English skills are highly preferred to support global customers and cross-regional collaboration.
  • Willing and able to travel frequently domestically and internationally as required to fulfill service obligations.
  • Customer-focused mindset, strong sense of responsibility, attention to detail, and professional work ethic with a commitment to quality service.

All listed requirements are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodations for additional tasks and responsibilities.

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Prior experience servicing NGS sequencers, PCR instruments, or other laboratory genomic/analytical equipment is strongly preferred.
  • Experience delivering technical training, supporting distributor service teams, or managing multi-site service operations.
  • Familiarity with medical device quality systems, including ISO13485, GMP, or relevant regulatory compliance standards.
  • Advanced hands-on expertise with electrical, mechanical, and optical components of precision laboratory instruments.
  • Experience supporting global customers or cross-cultural technical collaboration.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills and ability to work independently with minimal supervision in field settings.

Who We Are

GeneMind is a leading global innovator and manufacturer of next-generation sequencing (NGS) systems, powered by independent core intellectual property. We develop and deliver high-performance, reliable sequencing solutions to empower precision medicine, scientific research, and public health initiatives worldwide.

We are deeply committed to fostering an inclusive, supportive workplace that values diversity, professional growth, and collaborative innovation. We prioritize employee development, encourage curiosity, and empower every team member to make a meaningful impact on our mission to advance genomic technology for global health equity.

Equal Opportunity Employer: We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

description:

Características que valorizamos em si:

Se procura oportunidades de crescimento, formação, inovação e quer fazer parte de uma grande equipe, esta proposta é para você!

title: Drug Safety Physician
description:
*REMOTE OPPORTUNITY BUT MUST BE LOCATED IN BRAZIL & FLUENT IN ENGLISH*

The Pharmacovigilance (PV) Drug Safety Physician provides expert medical safety analysis for periodic safety aggregate reports (e.g., DSUR, PSUR/PBRER, ACO, RMP, PADER, bridging reports, signal reports, literature articles, health authority requests/queries and other relevant aggregate reports for pharmaceutical products and biologics/biosimilars).

The PV Drug Safety Physician should be able to perform medical review of all types of individual case safety reports (ICSRs) by writing an expert company pharmacovigilance comment. The PV Drug Safety Physician maintains distinctive quality and commitment as the operating philosophy in carrying out all processes and continually seeks out ways to enhance medical expertise in team both internally and externally.

  • Provides medical review of safety events (pre-marketing, post-marketing, device, and drug) and/or other medically related information per assigned tasks and project-specific procedures.
  • Provides input and review relevant safety information for signal detection and risk management activities.
  • Performs safety review of clinical and diagnostic data as part of case processing and aggregate reporting.
  • Provide medical review of aggregate reports (e.g., PSUR, PBRER, DSUR, and ASR).
  • Literature and medical review of the literature search strategy.
  • Serves as the main pharmacovigilance/safety physician point of contact for the customer for the life cycle of assigned projects.
  • Is a member of the signal management committee.
  • Assists with identifying out of scope activities in conjunction with the PV Project lead (as applicable).
  • Attends project team and client meetings (including Investigator meetings) and teleconferences as required.
  • Participates in Business Development activities as requested.
  • Performs other activities as identified and requested by management.
  • Provides input and consultancy to the client in the course of generation of the Company Core Data Sheet/Core Safety Information and Product Information.
  • Provides guidance to Pharmacovigilance and Safety Services staff with regards to the regulatory reporting of adverse events.
  • Assists with generation of project specific procedures (medical review workflow activities).
  • Supports QPPV and management as required.
  • Must regularly liaise with peer medical reviewers and also with vendor medical reviewers in assessing expert outcomes or opinions for all Safety reports.
  • Provides training on medically relevant topics, as and when required.
  • Providing oversight for overall PV and medical science for relevant medical products.
  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Gerente de contas

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: Tax Specialist
description:

  • Project management and process improvement capabilities.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

O dia a dia da oportunidade:

  • Atender demandas internacionais, com foco nos países da América Latina (LATAM), assegurando conformidade com regulamentações locais.

title: Remote Litigation Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's dispute resolution work in Brazil: commercial contract disputes, shareholder and post-M&A disputes, technology and IP disputes, debt recovery, and arbitration.
  • Lead case strategy, pleadings, evidence, and procedural steps for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies.
  • Advise clients on litigation risk before disputes arise — contract audits, escalation strategy, settlement positioning, and dispute resolution clauses.
  • Draft and negotiate letters before action, settlement agreements, and standstill and tolling arrangements; represent clients in mediation, arbitration, and court proceedings where licensed to do so.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising commercial litigation or arbitration in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with contract disputes — breach, termination, damages, limitation of liability, and injunctive relief.
  • Advocacy and procedure. Confident managing proceedings end-to-end, with rights of audience or substantial arbitration experience (ICC, LCIA, or local institutions).
  • Strong drafting under pressure. Pleadings, witness statements, and settlement terms that hold up.
  • Commercial judgment. You know when to fight, when to settle, and how to explain the difference to a client.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Bring modern tooling to dispute work — faster case preparation, sharper strategy, and clients who value clarity over billable churn.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

description:

Isso é a Zamp®: um ecossistema de restaurantes e pessoas em constante evolução.

Como será o seu desafio?

  • Atuar como referência técnica em temas tributários estratégicos, especialmente envolvendo ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS, IRPJ, CSLL, retenções e tributos incidentes sobre importações.
  • Apoiar a liderança tributária na avaliação de impactos fiscais sobre operações comerciais, cadeias de suprimentos, centros de distribuição, lojas, contratos, serviços, royalties, importações e demais fluxos operacionais.
  • Avaliar oportunidades tributárias, créditos fiscais, regimes especiais, benefícios fiscais e teses tributárias, considerando viabilidade técnica, impactos financeiros, riscos, documentação suporte e governança.
  • Elaborar análises, pareceres internos, memorandos técnicos e materiais executivos para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Avaliar impactos tributários em linhas relevantes do negócio, como receita bruta, receita líquida, impostos sobre vendas, custos, CMV, despesas, EBITDA e fluxo de caixa.
  • Apoiar discussões relacionadas à Reforma Tributária, incluindo impactos de IBS, CBS, Imposto Seletivo, transição, créditos, precificação, margem, cash flow, sistemas e obrigações acessórias.

title: Import Specialist
description:
About Meelunie

Meelunie is a global supplier of agricultural ingredients—specializing in plant-based starches, proteins, and sweeteners for food, feed, and industrial applications. Headquartered in Amsterdam, our global footprint spans offices across Europe, Asia, Australia, and the Americas.

As we scale our operations via Meelunie Do Brasil, we are expanding our local footprint to support key global accounts and build out our long-term distribution network across the region.

Position Overview

We are seeking an autonomous, proactive Import Specialist to take full operational ownership of our inbound container shipments into Brazil.

Reporting directly to global logistics leadership, you will oversee the complete ocean import lifecycle: from origin booking to customs release and final warehouse arrival. Because you will be joining a lean local setup supported by external providers, success in this role requires high self-reliance, rigorous attention to regulatory deadlines, and a drive to solve delays before they happen.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor container shipments end-to-end immediately post-departure, tracking carrier schedules, container positions, and updated ETAs to maintain real-time visibility.
  • Act as the main driver for customs clearance once cargo touches Brazilian ports, directly managing and expediting clearances involving MAPA and ANVISA to ensure rapid container release.
  • Supervise external customs brokers and local service partners, driving proactive follow-ups rather than waiting for status updates to avoid costly demurrage, detention, and storage fees.
  • Work closely with international trading desks in Europe, overseas sourcing teams, and domestic partners while adapting seamlessly across different business cultures and time zones.
  • Coordinate with our outsourced warehouse and freight partners in Brazil to hand off cleared inventory efficiently.

Requirements & Competencies

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in ocean container imports in Brazil, within the food industry.
  • Professional Portuguese and English fluency (the recruitment process and daily international communications will be conducted in English)
  • Strong knowledge of MAPA and ANVISA procedures and requirements is a must!
  • Demonstrated experience with Brazilian customs procedures and import regulations.
  • Experience managing import operations through Santa Catarina and São Paulo.
  • Experience working with shipping lines, customs brokers, port authorities and warehouse operators.
  • Knowledge of Incoterms and international trade documentation.
  • Experience with ERP systems; experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (F&O) is preferred.
  • Ability to process and audit import documentation accurately.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent organizational and planning skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple import files simultaneously.

What We Offer

Joining Meelunie Do Brasil offers a flexible work setup built on trust, total ownership, and true operational autonomy. You will have a direct impact on building and scaling local logistics processes for a globally recognized trading entity, taking full charge of your work while gaining valuable daily exposure to dynamic, international commercial and supply chain teams.

Please note that only applications submitted with a CV in English will be considered.
